definition.en: The open-hardware licence under which a cartridge's object is released, declared in the manifest as machine-readable data rather than left to a file in the repository. Both commons ship CERN-OHL-W-2.0 for their objects, which is what makes a bridge between them safe to build on.
definition.es: La licencia de hardware abierto bajo la que se publica el objeto de un cartucho, declarada en el manifiesto como dato legible por máquina en lugar de dejarse a un archivo del repositorio. Ambos procomunes publican sus objetos bajo CERN-OHL-W-2.0, que es lo que hace seguro construir un puente entre ellos.
definition.fr: La licence de matériel libre sous laquelle l'objet d'une cartouche est publié, déclarée dans le manifeste comme une donnée lisible par machine plutôt que laissée à un fichier du dépôt. Les deux communs publient leurs objets sous CERN-OHL-W-2.0, ce qui rend sûr d'y bâtir un pont.
definition.pt: A licença de hardware aberto sob a qual o objeto de um cartucho é publicado, declarada no manifesto como dado legível por máquina em vez de ficar entregue a um ficheiro do repositório. Os dois comuns publicam os seus objetos sob CERN-OHL-W-2.0, que é o que torna seguro construir uma ponte entre eles.

aliases.name: hyperobject.commons_license
aliases.note: Declared in BOTH project.attribution.license and hyperobject.commons_license, and the compliance lane fails a disagreement between them.

aliases.name: commons_license
aliases.note: Per-cartridge field carried through into the published commons catalog.

constraints: A published open-hardware grant is irrevocable for the versions it was published on, so a 'pending' licence is a one-way door: fashion-cabinet's compliance lane treats the old `LicenseRef-FC1-pending` sentinel as a hard error from the ruling date forward.
